---
title: "North Sea Horse Mackerel (hom.27.4bc7d) - Short-term forecast"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
params:
  model_file: "model/model_final.RData"
  imy_catch: 970   # assumed intermediate-year catch = the quota (t)
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    df_print: kable
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(FLCore)
library(FLAssess)
library(stockassessment)
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(FLSAM)))  # ssb()/rec()/fbar() with CIs off the SAM fit
library(FLash)          # loaded last so FLash::fwd / fwdControl win
library(icesTAF)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_bw())

stockcode <- "hom.27.4bc7d"

# one output tree per model run, keyed off the model file name (benchmark / final / ...)
run_name <- sub("^model_", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$model_file)))

FIG_DIR  <- file.path("report/figures", run_name)
FC_DIR   <- file.path("forecast", run_name)
mkdir("report"); mkdir(FIG_DIR); mkdir(FC_DIR)

# same helper as report.Rmd: save the figure to FIG_DIR at print resolution, then embed it
save_and_show <- function(p, filename, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, filename)
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  } else {
    png(path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi, bg = "white")
    on.exit(dev.off())
    p()
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}
```

```{r load}
load(params$model_file, verbose = FALSE)   # NSHOM, NSHOM.tun, NSHOM.sam, NSHOM.ctrl, NSHOM.retro, NSHOM.loo
hom <- NSHOM

# forecast years derived from the assessment's own terminal year (no manual rollover)
termYr <- NSHOM@range[["maxyear"]]
ImY <- termYr + 1L   # intermediate year
AdY <- termYr + 2L   # advice year
CtY <- termYr + 3L   # continuation year

# Intermediate-year catch assumption = the quota (external assumption, not from
# the data); pass params$imy_catch to override.
ImY.catch     <- as.numeric(params$imy_catch)
ImY.catch.src <- "assumed quota"

pg     <- hom@range[["max"]]
fbrng  <- hom@range[c("minfbar", "maxfbar")]
```

# `r NSHOM@name` - forecast for `r ImY`-`r CtY`

Assessment: **`r params$model_file`** (terminal year `r termYr`).
Fbar range **`r fbrng[["minfbar"]]`-`r fbrng[["maxfbar"]]`**.
Assumed `r ImY` catch: **`r format(round(ImY.catch), big.mark = ",")` t** (`r ImY.catch.src`).

# 2025 ICES advice sheet (for reference)

Reproduced from *ICES Advice 2025 - hom.27.4bc7d* (published 30 September 2025;
[doi:10.17895/ices.advice.27202656](https://doi.org/10.17895/ices.advice.27202656)).
These are last year's published values, except that the 2025 total catch and F in
Table 1 have been replaced with the realised values now available from the
current assessment (2025 is a real data year in this run). The forecast below is
this year's update.

# Forecast assumptions

## Recruitment

Recruitment for `r ImY`-`r CtY` is the **geometric mean of the last 10 recruitments**
(`r termYr-9`-`r termYr`).

```{r recruitment}
rec.years <- (termYr - 9):termYr

hom.srr <- as.FLSR(trim(hom, year = rec.years))
model(hom.srr) <- "geomean"
hom.srr <- try(fmle(hom.srr, control = list(trace = 0)), silent = TRUE)
if (inherits(hom.srr, "try-error")) {
  hom.srr <- as.FLSR(trim(hom, year = rec.years)); model(hom.srr) <- "geomean"
}

rgm <- exp(mean(log(rec(NSHOM)[, ac(rec.years)])))
params(hom.srr)["a", ] <- rgm

rec_df <- as.data.frame(rec(NSHOM)[, ac(rec.years)])[, c("year", "data")]
p_rec <- ggplot(rec_df, aes(factor(year), data, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") + geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = rgm, colour = "#1f6feb", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = rgm, vjust = -0.6, hjust = 0, colour = "#1f6feb",
           label = paste0("geomean = ", format(round(rgm), big.mark = ","))) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = sprintf("Recruitment (age %d)", hom@range[["min"]]),
       title = paste0(stockcode, " - recruitments used for the geometric mean"))
save_and_show(p_rec, "proj_recruitment_geomean.png", height = 5)
```

## Plus-group mean weight

The plus-group (age `r pg`) mean weight is not observed in the most recent years;
non-positive values are carried forward from the last year with data.

```{r plusgroup-weights, results='asis'}
fill_pg <- function(stk, slt) {
  q   <- slot(stk, slt)
  yrs <- dimnames(q)$year
  v   <- as.numeric(q[ac(pg), ])
  good <- which(is.finite(v) & v > 0)
  changed <- character(0)
  for (i in seq_along(v)) {
    if ((!is.finite(v[i]) || v[i] <= 0) && any(good < i)) {
      src <- max(good[good < i])
      slot(stk, slt)[ac(pg), yrs[i]] <- v[src]
      changed <- c(changed, sprintf("%s <- %s (%.4f)", yrs[i], yrs[src], v[src]))
    }
  }
  list(stk = stk, changed = changed)
}

chg <- list()
for (slt in c("stock.wt", "catch.wt")) {
  r <- fill_pg(hom, slt); hom <- r$stk
  chg[[slt]] <- r$changed
}

if (length(unlist(chg)) == 0) {
  cat("*No plus-group weight substitutions were needed.*\n")
} else {
  for (slt in names(chg)) if (length(chg[[slt]]))
    cat("- **", slt, "** age ", pg, ": ", paste(chg[[slt]], collapse = "; "), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

# Catch options

```{r options-list}
options.l <- setNames(list(
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "f", "f"),
                        val = c(ImY.catch, 0.0, 0.0))),
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "f", "f"),
                        rel.year = c(NA, ImY, AdY), val = c(ImY.catch, 1, 1))),
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "catch", "f"),
                        rel.year = c(NA, NA, AdY), val = c(ImY.catch, ImY.catch * 0.80, 1))),
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "catch", "f"),
                        rel.year = c(NA, NA, AdY), val = c(ImY.catch, ImY.catch, 1))),
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "catch", "f"),
                        rel.year = c(NA, NA, AdY), val = c(ImY.catch, ImY.catch * 1.25, 1)))
), c("F = 0",
     sprintf("F%d = F%d", AdY, ImY),
     sprintf("Catch%d = Catch%d - 20%%", AdY, ImY),
     sprintf("Catch%d = Catch%d", AdY, ImY),
     sprintf("Catch%d = Catch%d + 25%%", AdY, ImY)))

hom.options <- lapply(options.l, function(ctr) fwd(hom.proj, ctrl = ctr, sr = hom.srr))
names(hom.options) <- names(options.l)
```

```{r options-summary}
opt_sum_tbl <- function(stcks) {
  rows <- lapply(names(stcks), function(nm) {
    stk <- stcks[[nm]]
    tsb <- function(y) c(quantSums(stock.wt(stk) * stock.n(stk))[, ac(y), drop = TRUE])
    data.frame(
      Rationale        = nm,
      `Fbar (ImY)`     = c(fbar(stk)[, ac(ImY), drop = TRUE]),
      `Catch (ImY)`    = c(computeCatch(stk)[, ac(ImY), drop = TRUE]),
      `SSB (ImY)`      = c(ssb(stk)[, ac(ImY), drop = TRUE]),
      `TSB (ImY)`      = tsb(ImY),
      `Fbar (AdY)`     = c(fbar(stk)[, ac(AdY), drop = TRUE]),
      `Catch (AdY)`    = c(computeCatch(stk)[, ac(AdY), drop = TRUE]),
      `SSB (AdY)`      = c(ssb(stk)[, ac(AdY), drop = TRUE]),
      `TSB (AdY)`      = tsb(AdY),
      `SSB (CtY)`      = c(ssb(stk)[, ac(CtY), drop = TRUE]),
      `TSB (CtY)`      = tsb(CtY),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  names(out) <- c("Rationale",
                  sprintf("Fbar (%d)", ImY), sprintf("Catch (%d)", ImY), sprintf("SSB (%d)", ImY), sprintf("TSB (%d)", ImY),
                  sprintf("Fbar (%d)", AdY), sprintf("Catch (%d)", AdY), sprintf("SSB (%d)", AdY), sprintf("TSB (%d)", AdY),
                  sprintf("SSB (%d)", CtY), sprintf("TSB (%d)", CtY))
  out
}

opts_sum <- opt_sum_tbl(hom.options)
write.csv(opts_sum, file.path(FC_DIR, "options - summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

opts_show <- opts_sum
num <- sapply(opts_show, is.numeric)
opts_show[num] <- lapply(opts_show[num], function(x) round(x, ifelse(max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE) < 1, 4, 0)))
kable(opts_show, caption = sprintf("Catch options (ImY = %d, AdY = %d, CtY = %d). Written to %s/options - summary.csv",
                                   ImY, AdY, CtY, FC_DIR))
```

```{r options-detail-csv}
# detailed N- and F-at-age table per option (same layout as model_STF.r)
tbl.yrs <- ac(ImY:CtY)
detail_file <- file.path(FC_DIR, "options - details.csv")
write.table(NULL, file = detail_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
for (i in seq_along(hom.options)) {
  stk <- hom.options[[i]]
  nums <- stk@stock.n[, tbl.yrs, drop = TRUE]; colnames(nums) <- sprintf("N(%s)", tbl.yrs)
  fs   <- stk@harvest[, tbl.yrs, drop = TRUE]; colnames(fs)   <- sprintf("F(%s)", tbl.yrs)
  age.tbl <- cbind(Age = rownames(fs), N = nums, F = fs)
  sum.tbl <- cbind(Year = tbl.yrs, SSB = ssb(stk)[, tbl.yrs],
                   F.bar = fbar(stk)[, tbl.yrs], Yield = computeCatch(stk)[, tbl.yrs])
  pad <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(age.tbl) - nrow(sum.tbl), ncol = ncol(sum.tbl))
  comb <- cbind(age.tbl, " ", rbind(sum.tbl, pad))
  write.table(sprintf("%s). %s", letters[i], names(hom.options)[i]), detail_file,
              append = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = ",")
  write.table(t(colnames(comb)), detail_file, append = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = ",")
  write.table(comb, detail_file, append = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = ",")
  write.table("", detail_file, append = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, sep = ",")
}
```

# SSB: assessment and projection

```{r ssb-projection, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
# historical SSB from the assessment (point series up to the terminal year)
ssb_hist <- as.data.frame(ssb(hom))[, c("year", "data")]
names(ssb_hist) <- c("year", "ssb")
ssb_hist <- subset(ssb_hist, year <= termYr)

# 95% CI band from the SAM fit, if the fitted object carries one
ssb_ci <- tryCatch({
  d <- as.data.frame(FLCore::ssb(NSHOM.sam))
  keep <- intersect(c("lbnd", "ubnd"), names(d))
  if (length(keep) == 2) {
    d <- d[, c("year", "lbnd", "ubnd")]
    subset(d, year <= termYr)
  } else NULL
}, error = function(e) NULL)

# projected SSB per catch option, started at termYr so the lines join the history
ssb_proj <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(hom.options), function(nm) {
  s <- as.data.frame(ssb(hom.options[[nm]]))[, c("year", "data")]
  names(s) <- c("year", "ssb")
  s <- subset(s, year >= termYr & year <= CtY)
  s$option <- nm
  s
}))
ssb_proj$option <- factor(ssb_proj$option, levels = names(hom.options))

p_ssb_proj <- ggplot() +
  {if (!is.null(ssb_ci))
     geom_ribbon(data = ssb_ci, aes(year, ymin = lbnd, ymax = ubnd),
                 fill = "grey85", colour = NA)} +
  geom_line(data = ssb_hist, aes(year, ssb), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = termYr + 0.5, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = refpts[["Blim"]], colour = "#d1242f", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = refpts[["Bpa"]],  colour = "#bf8700", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = ssb_proj, aes(year, ssb, colour = option), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = ssb_proj, aes(year, ssb, colour = option), size = 1.8) +
  annotate("text", x = min(ssb_hist$year), y = refpts[["Blim"]], label = "Blim",
           colour = "#d1242f", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.3) +
  annotate("text", x = min(ssb_hist$year), y = refpts[["Bpa"]], label = "Bpa",
           colour = "#bf8700", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "SSB (t)", colour = "Catch option",
       title = sprintf("%s - SSB: assessment (to %d) and %d-%d projection", stockcode, termYr, ImY, CtY))

save_and_show(p_ssb_proj, "proj_ssb_blim.png", width = 11, height = 6)
```

# Relative biomass (category-3 style summary)

Assessment quantities expressed **relative to the time-series mean**, mirroring the
ICES *cod.27.22-24* (western Baltic cod) advice sheet - where the assessment is
treated as a category-3 SSB-*trend* index rather than an absolute estimate.
Recruitment, SSB and harvest rate (catch / SSB) are each divided by their own
`r NSHOM@range[["minyear"]]`-`r termYr` mean; `High` / `Low` are the 95% SAM
confidence bounds carried through the same scaling. Written to
`r file.path(FC_DIR, "assessment summary - relative.csv")`.

```{r relative-biomass}
sam_tab <- function(fn) {
  d <- as.data.frame(fn(NSHOM.sam))              # year, value, CV, lbnd, ubnd
  d[, c("year", "value", "lbnd", "ubnd")]
}
ssb_s <- sam_tab(FLCore::ssb); names(ssb_s) <- c("year", "SSB", "SSB_lo", "SSB_hi")
rec_s <- sam_tab(FLCore::rec); names(rec_s) <- c("year", "Rec", "Rec_lo", "Rec_hi")

cat_s <- as.data.frame(catch(NSHOM))[, c("year", "data")]   # observed catch (t)
names(cat_s) <- c("year", "Catch_t")

rel <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "year"), list(ssb_s, rec_s, cat_s))
rel <- rel[rel$year <= termYr, ]
rel$HR <- rel$Catch_t / rel$SSB                              # harvest rate

ssb_bar <- mean(rel$SSB); rec_bar <- mean(rel$Rec); hr_bar <- mean(rel$HR)

rel_out <- data.frame(
  Year          = rel$year,
  Rel_SSB       = rel$SSB    / ssb_bar,
  Rel_SSB_Low   = rel$SSB_lo / ssb_bar,
  Rel_SSB_High  = rel$SSB_hi / ssb_bar,
  Rel_Rec       = rel$Rec    / rec_bar,
  Rel_Rec_Low   = rel$Rec_lo / rec_bar,
  Rel_Rec_High  = rel$Rec_hi / rec_bar,
  Rel_HarvestRate = rel$HR / hr_bar,
  SSB_t         = rel$SSB,
  Rec_thousands = rel$Rec / 1000,
  Catch_t       = rel$Catch_t
)
rel_out[-1] <- lapply(rel_out[-1], round, 4)
write.csv(rel_out, file.path(FC_DIR, "assessment summary - relative.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# companion file: the reference levels and the biomass ref points on the same scale
ref_levels <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c("mean SSB (t)", "mean recruitment (thousands)",
               "mean harvest rate (catch/SSB)", "Blim (t)", "Bpa (t)",
               "Blim relative to mean SSB", "Bpa relative to mean SSB", "Years"),
  Value = c(round(ssb_bar), round(rec_bar / 1000), round(hr_bar, 4),
            refpts[["Blim"]], refpts[["Bpa"]],
            round(refpts[["Blim"]] / ssb_bar, 4), round(refpts[["Bpa"]] / ssb_bar, 4),
            sprintf("%d-%d", min(rel$year), termYr))
)
write.csv(ref_levels, file.path(FC_DIR, "assessment summary - relative reference levels.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

kable(rel_out[, c("Year", "Rel_SSB", "Rel_SSB_Low", "Rel_SSB_High",
                  "Rel_Rec", "Rel_HarvestRate", "SSB_t", "Catch_t")],
      caption = sprintf(paste0("Relative assessment summary, %d-%d ",
                               "(mean SSB = %s t; Blim = %s of the mean, Bpa = %s). ",
                               "Full table + reference levels in %s/"),
                        min(rel$year), termYr, format(round(ssb_bar), big.mark = ","),
                        round(refpts[["Blim"]] / ssb_bar, 2),
                        round(refpts[["Bpa"]]  / ssb_bar, 2), FC_DIR))
```

```{r relative-biomass-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
blim_rel <- refpts[["Blim"]] / ssb_bar
bpa_rel  <- refpts[["Bpa"]]  / ssb_bar

base_rel <- list(

  theme_bw(base_size = 11),
  labs(x = NULL)
)

p_rs <- ggplot(rel_out, aes(Year, Rel_SSB)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Rel_SSB_Low, ymax = Rel_SSB_High), fill = "#1f6feb", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = "#1f6feb", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = blim_rel, colour = "#d1242f", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bpa_rel,  colour = "#bf8700", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = min(rel_out$Year), y = blim_rel, label = "Blim", colour = "#d1242f",
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2) +
  annotate("text", x = min(rel_out$Year), y = bpa_rel, label = "Bpa", colour = "#bf8700",
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2) +
  base_rel + ylim(0, NA) +
  labs(y = "Relative SSB", title = paste0(stockcode, " - assessment relative to the ",
       min(rel_out$Year), "-", termYr, " mean"),
       subtitle = "Ribbon = 95% SAM CI; grey line = time-series mean (= 1)")

p_rr <- ggplot(rel_out, aes(Year, Rel_Rec)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Rel_Rec_Low, ymax = Rel_Rec_High), fill = "#2da44e", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2da44e", linewidth = 0.9) +
  base_rel + ylim(0, NA) + labs(y = "Relative recruitment (age 1)")

p_rh <- ggplot(rel_out, aes(Year, Rel_HarvestRate)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#8250df", linewidth = 0.9) +
  base_rel + ylim(0, NA) + labs(y = "Relative harvest rate (catch / SSB)", x = "Year")

save_and_show(p_rs / p_rr / p_rh, "proj_relative_summary.png", width = 10, height = 9)
```

# Yield and SSB against F

```{r fsweep}
fmult.targs <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.002)
mult.opts.l <- lapply(fmult.targs, function(fm)
  fwdControl(data.frame(year = c(ImY, AdY, CtY), quantity = c("catch", "f", "f"),
                        val = c(ImY.catch, fm, fm))))
names(mult.opts.l) <- sprintf("Fmult(%d) = %5.3f", ImY, fmult.targs)

hom.mult.opts <- lapply(mult.opts.l, function(ctr) fwd(hom.proj, ctrl = ctr, sr = hom.srr))
names(hom.mult.opts) <- names(mult.opts.l)

mult_sum <- opt_sum_tbl(hom.mult.opts)
write.csv(mult_sum, file.path(FC_DIR, "multi-options - summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fsweep-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
fbar_col  <- sprintf("Fbar (%d)", AdY)
catch_col <- sprintf("Catch (%d)", AdY)
ssb_col   <- sprintf("SSB (%d)", CtY)

named <- opts_sum %>%
  transmute(Rationale, fbar = .data[[fbar_col]], catch = .data[[catch_col]], ssb = .data[[ssb_col]])

p_y <- ggplot(mult_sum, aes(.data[[fbar_col]], .data[[catch_col]])) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = named, aes(fbar, catch, colour = Rationale), size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = sprintf("Fbar %d", AdY), y = sprintf("Catch %d (t)", AdY), colour = NULL, title = "Yield vs F") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_s <- ggplot(mult_sum, aes(.data[[fbar_col]], .data[[ssb_col]])) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = named, aes(fbar, ssb, colour = Rationale), size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = sprintf("Fbar %d", AdY), y = sprintf("SSB %d (t)", CtY), colour = NULL, title = "SSB vs F")

save_and_show(p_y + p_s + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.4)),
              "proj_yield_ssb_vs_f.png", width = 12, height = 5)
```

# Forecast input table

```{r input-table}
input.tbl.list <- list(N = "stock.n", M = "m", Mat = "mat", PF = "harvest.spwn",
                       PM = "m.spwn", SWt = "stock.wt", Sel = "harvest", CWt = "catch.wt")
input_file <- file.path(FC_DIR, "options - input.csv")
write.table(NULL, file = input_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
for (yr in c(ImY, AdY, CtY)) {
  col.dat <- sapply(input.tbl.list, function(slt) slot(hom.proj, slt)[, ac(yr), drop = TRUE])
  write.table(yr, input_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE, sep = ",")
  write.table(t(c("Age", colnames(col.dat))), input_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE, sep = ",")
  write.table(col.dat, input_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, append = TRUE, sep = ",", na = "-")
  write.table("", input_file, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, append = TRUE, sep = ",")
}

imy_in <- sapply(input.tbl.list, function(slt) slot(hom.proj, slt)[, ac(ImY), drop = TRUE])
kable(round(as.data.frame(imy_in), 4),
      caption = sprintf("Forecast inputs at age, %d (full %d-%d table in %s/options - input.csv)",
                        ImY, ImY, CtY, FC_DIR))
```
